description.value: Taco Bell on Island Highway North is a franchise fast food location serving Mexican-inspired items including tacos, burritos, and the Crunchwrap Supreme. The location offers both drive-through and dine-in service, making it a convenient quick stop for cyclists traveling the Island Highway corridor north of Nanaimo. A dedicated Veggie Cravings Menu provides vegetarian options.

address.value: 6896 Island Highway North, Nanaimo, BC V9V 1P6
